name: Christina Eberle
text: In restful, we found a partner who understands our vision: connecting people affected and their families as equals. Working together to develop the exchange platform for people with cystic fibrosis was professional and collaborative throughout. The result speaks for itself: a safe and effective peer programme that creates genuine exchange and mutual support. I can recommend restful as a development partner without reservation.
